notes: A060298_even: a(2n)/10^n -> 1 - 1/sqrt 10; A060298_odd: a(2n+1)/10^(n+1) -> 1/sqrt 10 - 1/10, a N = #pairs (x,y), x,y >= 2, x^y with N digits. Squares give isqrt(10^N-1) - isqrt(10^(N-1)-1) = r^N - r^(N-1) + O(1); y >= 3 pairs have x < 3^N, y < 4N. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (check.py: 15 data terms).
